items.title: Bristol Myers Squibb (BMY) Expands Neuroscience Push With Multi Year AI Alliance
items.summary: Bristol Myers Squibb (NYSE:BMY) has entered a multi-year collaboration with Pathos AI and Tempus AI focused on neuroscience. The alliance aims to build an AI-driven dataset and analytical toolkit targeting Alzheimer's disease and other neurological conditions. Partners plan to integrate large-scale patient information with AI-powered hypothesis testing to support precision medicine and trial design. items.title: Bristol Myers Squibb (BMY) Wins FDA Approval, Is The Rally Already Priced In?
items.summary: Bristol-Myers Squibb (BMY) is back in the spotlight after the FDA granted accelerated approval for ZENBEXUS in multiple myeloma, along with fresh positive trial updates in lung cancer and multiple sclerosis. Recent moves suggest investors are rewarding this stream of drug updates. The share price is up 4.02% over 1 day, 9.15% over 30 days and 20.07% year to date, while the 1-year total shareholder return of 44.28% points to momentum that has been building rather than fading.
